coreAudit.upstream: Google music-synthesizer-for-android, pinned f67d41d313b7dc85f6fb99e79e515cc9d208cfff; local MSFA ownership, scalar portability, bounded phase arithmetic and live parameter modifications retained
coreAudit.voiceParameters: Six operators, 32 algorithms. Exactly 155 unpacked VCED bytes copied through voice_ptr; wire operator order OP6..OP1; voice IDs identify bank-slot note cohorts. C ABI itself accepts raw bytes; public JS validates complete input first.
coreAudit.polyphony: 16 active slots. Round-robin allocation searches only slots with keydown false; a 17th keydown while all 16 held is ignored. Releasing voices may be reused; overlapping same-pitch note-off releases all matching held slots.
coreAudit.liveEdits: EditVoice affects matching-ID live slots, including release tails: output level, oscillator mode/coarse/fine/detune and feedback update without restarting envelopes, phase or feedback history. EG/algorithm/scaling/name are future-note fields. Shared LFO is reset only if its six controls changed. No automatic smoothing for abrupt frequency/feedback edits.
coreAudit.selection: SelectVoice changes future-note parameters and shared LFO, preserving active captured note parameters. Unexpected EditVoice ID becomes selection, never an edit of another cohort. SetVoice uses ID zero.
coreAudit.clocking: Core fixed 44100 Hz; each module has independent memory/static LUT initialization. MSFA internal DSP blocks are64 samples; wrapper accepts0..1024 mono frames and writes int16 PCM normalized by32768. No configurable chip clock API.
coreAudit.output: Mono; pan/stereo and output gain are host mixer functions. C wrapper uses fixed output and 155-byte voice arrays; no malloc/free export or borrowed stereo API. Module memory fixed16MiB, stack1MiB, no growth.
coreAudit.releaseAndReset: allNotesOff releases held/sustained notes without hard silence; panic deletes/recreates SynthUnit and reapplies selected voice; JS additionally clears 48k interpolation and queued64-frame state. No native save/load/read/status/IRQ/register bus/reset export.
coreAudit.lifecycle: Per-handle SynthUnit owns its16Dx7Note allocations. Module-global immutable LUTs initialized once at44100; no native sampling-rate mutation. Fixed-memory module excludes growing heap and JS pointer invalidation from memory growth.

consumerAudit.publicCore: web/msfa_dx7/src/index.js createDX7 loads standalone WASM with env.abort/wasi.proc_exit, calls optional_initialize and12DX7exports; synchronous note/render/preset methods plus async SysEx loading; constructor may expose upstream initial electric-piano until a validated preset is selected.
consumerAudit.sampleRates: Public output44100/48000 only.44100 renders directly;48000 uses integer-phase linear interpolation from44100 with at mostone64-frame block prefetch; partition-invariant state lives in JS, unchanged. render returns owned Float32Array;renderInto writes caller Float32Array.
